snippet.title: Can I Take Your Order? - Demo Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Can I Take Your Order? demo is out now! 🎮
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4580810/Can_I_Take_Your_Order/

Add it to your wishlist! Full game coming soon! 🎊

You and your friends play as part time waiters in different restaurants. Use your bare hands to deliver food, taze a raging cowboy who just shot someone and dispose of the body before it starts to stink. Keep your customers happy on your own, or with up to 3 friends in online co-op.
